item.title: Over 90,000 Vehicles M-Tagged in Islamabad Since Last Month
item.description: Islamabad: The Islamabad Capital Territory (ICT) administration has accelerated its M-Tag registration campaign, issuing a total of 90,164 vehicle tags since November 14.
